text:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝟭𝟭𝟲/𝟲! 😬🇮🇳

Day 2 stumps in Christchurch: India trail NZ's 356 by 240 runs.
Jamieson 2/33, Duffy 2/21; Rahul top-scored with 25. Jurel 7* at the close.

Can India fight back? 👇
#INDvNZ #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝟭𝟭𝟲/𝟲, 𝟮𝟰𝟬 𝗣𝗜𝗖𝗛𝗛𝗘! 😬🇮🇳

👉 Christchurch Test ke Day 2 ke end par India 116/6, New Zealand ke 356 se 240 run peeche
👉 Jamieson (2/33) aur Duffy (2/21) ne top order tod diya
👉 Rahul ne sabse zyada 25 banaye, Jurel 7* par hain

Kya India yahan se wapsi kar paayegi?

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
